paragraphs.text: viz., Of the ninth day of the first month, called Abib; as on the tenth day {Jos 4:19} - which was the day wherein the paschal lamb was set apart - the Israelites entered the land of Canaan under the command and conduct of Joshua, who was a type of Jesus Christ, by whom we have "the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory." {Eph 1:14}
paragraphs.anchor: And Joshua rose early in the morning

paragraphs.text: In the plains of Moab. See Jos 2:1.
paragraphs.anchor: Removed from Shittim.

paragraphs.text: i.e., Three days after that they were commanded to provide victuals. {a} {Jos 1:11}
paragraphs.anchor: After three days

paragraphs.text: {a} A mandato illo de parando viatico. - Trem.
Which represented that angel of the covenant, Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.anchor: When ye see the ark of the covenant.

paragraphs.text: The Koathites properly and ordinarily did this office, {Num 3:31} which as it had more honour, so more burden and danger. {Num 4:15}
paragraphs.anchor: And the priests the Levites bearing it.

paragraphs.text: “ Fructus honos oneris, fructus honoris onus. ”
God must and may be followed without peril. Magnus est animus qui se Deo tradidit, saith Seneca.
paragraphs.anchor: And go after it.

paragraphs.text: That you may know the distance, and show your reverence. See Exo 19:12. As also,
paragraphs.anchor: Yet there shall be a space.

paragraphs.text: i.e., Ut ignari vice tuto vado transire possitis, that ye may have a sure and safe passage through the river discovered unto you.
paragraphs.anchor: That you may know the way by which you must go

paragraphs.text: By ceremonial and spiritual purifications, doing your utmost to bring your hearts to a holy temper, that ye may make the best of the ensuing miracle.
paragraphs.anchor: Sanctify yourselves.

paragraphs.text: To the further side of the river, say some; to the middle only, say others, {as Jos 3:17} the pillar of cloud still going before them for a guide, as some conceive, but others doubt.
paragraphs.anchor: And went before the people.

paragraphs.text: viz., In the esteem of the people. It is God that giveth honour; he fashioneth men’s opinions: he caused that "whatsoever David did pleased the people."
paragraphs.anchor: This day will I begin to magnify thee

paragraphs.text: "Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord which he will show you today," as Exo 14:13. Believe and prosper: consent and obey, and ye shall eat the good things of the land.
paragraphs.anchor: Ye shall stand still in Jordan.

paragraphs.text: For miracles do but excite men; they do but as the bells that call us to the sermon, they cannot work faith in us: but faith cometh by hearing.
paragraphs.anchor: Come hither, and hear the words of the Lord your God.

paragraphs.text: "Living" and "giving," as 1Ti 6:17. "Trust in the living God, who giveth us all things richly to enjoy."
paragraphs.anchor: Hereby ye shall know that the living God.

paragraphs.text: To these seven were those ten nations {Gen 15:19} reduced, belike, either by mixture, or diminution of some of them.
paragraphs.anchor: The Canaanites, and the Hittites, &c.

paragraphs.text: Where the ark is, and where the ordinances are, there God is: hence the ark is called God’s face, {Psa 105:4} yea, God’s self. {Psa 132:5}
paragraphs.anchor: Behold the ark of the covenant, even the Lord of heaven and earth.

paragraphs.text: i.e., Now make choice of them for that service afterwards to be performed. {Jos 4:4} Potior est testis oculatus unus quam auriti decem. {a}
paragraphs.anchor: Now therefore take you twelve men

paragraphs.text: {a} Plaut.

A wonderful work of God, and much admired by the psalmist; {Psa 114:3; Psa 114:5} as was that - and worthily if it were true - by the philosopher, when from the hill Etna there ran down a torrent of fire that consumed all the houses thereabout; in the midst of those fearful flames, God’s special care of the godly, saith he, shined most brightly: ο γαρ πυρος ποταμος εξεχισθη, for the river of fire was divided, and a kind of lane made for those who ventured to rescue their aged parents, and pluck them out of the jaws of death. {a}
paragraphs.anchor: That the waters of Jordan shall be cut off.

paragraphs.text: {a} Aristot., De Mundo, cap. vi.
In Jos 3:13 it was, "And it shall come to pass." "The word of God cannot be broken"; {Joh 10:35} all must be fulfilled that is foretold.
paragraphs.anchor: And it came to pass.

paragraphs.text: Ordinarily every year; either ex fiuminis natura, {a} by the nature of this river, {see 1Ch 12:15} as it is also of the Nile, {b} or else by the melting of the snow from the mountains: the like whereunto befalleth Tigris and Euphrates.
paragraphs.anchor: For Jordan overfloweth his banks.

paragraphs.text: Barley harvest. Compare Lev 23:10. So that the Israelites were brought into the land at the best time. And "herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth." {Joh 4:37}
paragraphs.anchor: At the time of harvest.

paragraphs.text: {a} Tremell.
{b} Perinde at Nilus messis tempore alveos excedens et exundans maltum terrae irrigat. - Aristeas.
A city in the tribe of Ephraim, {1Ki 4:12; 1Ki 7:46} called also Zererath in Jdg 7:22, and Zereda in 1Ki 11:26.
paragraphs.anchor: That is beside Zaretan.

paragraphs.text: Quickly perished in the lake Asphaltites, or Dead Sea, Tanquam si repente fuissent dissectae gladio, ut Job 6:15, as if they had been suddenly cut in twain with a sword, {a}
paragraphs.anchor: Failed, and were cut off.

paragraphs.text: Not by bridges or boats, but on foot, dry shod, though in such an inundation.
paragraphs.anchor: And the people passed over.

paragraphs.text: The place being therehence called Bethabara, as some think, {Joh 1:28} or Traiectum, the place of passage. Here baptism was first administered, {Joh 1:28} where it had been foreshadowed. Christ is the true Bethabara. {Eph 2:18}
paragraphs.anchor: Right over against Jericho.

paragraphs.text: {a} Tremell.

He was a bold Israelite that first set foot on the water: but no "Israelite indeed" need fear to pass through corporal death, having the ark of God’s covenant in his eye, to take possession of the heavenly Canaan.
paragraphs.anchor: And all the Israelites passed over.
